results.scope: One frozen application-model proposal on two seven-regime seed panels. Ablations isolate outputs, not LLM necessity.

fixed.method: Paired market bootstrap, 10000 draws. Synthetic authored markets; not a production ROI interval.

numerical.method: Paired market bootstrap, 10000 draws. Synthetic authored markets; not a production ROI interval.

decision.expectedMechanism: Expanding the audience to positive EV inquiries increases outreach volume and potential conversions. Using funded_baskets fulfills these conversions efficiently without speculative inventory build-up, preserving partner cash while increasing platform and retailer USD.
decision.risk: Expanding the audience might increase outreach costs without proportional conversion gains if the positive EV threshold is miscalibrated. funded_baskets might miss some sales if speculative stock was actually needed for immediate fulfillment.
decision.rationale: The funded_baskets_interest fulfillment increased platform and retailer contribution but drained partner cash due to speculative interest-stock blending. By switching to funded_baskets, we plan complete authorized baskets using existing/incoming stock and shared cash before historical-demand buffer stock, protecting terminal cash. Using the consented_positive_value audience expands outreach to positive-expected-value inquiries, avoiding the failed pause policy. The existing model is retained as it outperformed the expert model in global campaign profit.

protocol.primary: Revised policy must improve settled modeled PayPal net after allocated decision cost over fixed and numerical; preserve total retailer and partner cash; closing inventory <=110% fixed; no unpaid liabilities. Report per-merchant deltas, paired cases, two panels, contributions and ablations. No automatic deployment or multi-agent superiority claim.

input.task: Propose one concrete joint campaign/fulfillment revision to raise settled modeled PayPal contribution while protecting total retailer contribution and closing partner cash. Keep the economy frozen. The earlier pause policy failed; do not stop outreach based on a quiet short window.

earlierHistoricalDesign.source: Different older development markets, not an apples-to-apples comparison. It used broader positive-expected-value inquiries and complete-basket planning.

audience.recent_interest: Current learned planner only contacts people with product interest in the last seven days, including general needs inquiries.
audience.consented_positive_value: Keep product recommendations tied to recent actual interest. Also permit general needs inquiries without recent interest when the learned payment AND retailer expected values are positive. Still respect consent, seven-day gaps, ten contacts/day, existing customer funds and the fixed budget.

fulfillment.fixed: Strong fixed joint current-stock allocation and recent14 seven-day stock cover.
fulfillment.funded_baskets: Plan complete already-authorized baskets using approved alternatives, existing/incoming stock and shared cash before historical-demand buffer stock. Existing tested program without speculative interest-stock blend.
fulfillment.funded_baskets_interest: The just-tested complete-basket and blended interest-stock program. It increased net but reduced partner cash.

model.existing: Existing purchase forest, funding calibration and inquiry reward posterior, with matured local feedback.
model.expert: Higher-ROC pooled model combining existing and observed-market-feedback forecasts; previously improved prediction but not global campaign profit.

input.scope: Authoring a new bounded combination, not selecting thresholds or guaranteeing a win. Outcomes are authored simulation money. Broader contact risks waste; more stock can manufacture supplier fees while draining partner cash. A prediction is not an incremental sale.
input.question: Which single combination should the trusted executor test, and what causal chain and risks should the evaluator check?
